description: This file is a PHP source file that handles routing logic for email rule management in the SuiteCRM platform, including actions like setting rule status, saving, deleting, and fetching rule metadata, primarily via switch-case statement based on request parameters.

classes.name: SugarRouting
classes.description: A class managing email routing rules, including setting status, saving, deleting, and fetching rules and related metadata.

classes.name: SugarDependentDropdown

classes.description: A generic CRM bean class used as a base for various data objects.
